result.title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
result.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Preliminary version; a revised version is in preparation. Code: https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/computewise. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/computewise
result.summary: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. Asking the agent to finish the work faster, telling it to keep every GPU busy, or giving it a job scheduler does not fix this. So we built an open-source harness, part prompting and part deterministic code. Across five models, it removed over 80% of the extra time to the answer.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ComputeWise 基准与自建模拟 GPU，测量 AI 研究 agent 的 GPU 时间中有多少真正用于产生答案所需的工作，并给出「提示词+确定性代码」的开源 harness 来削减无效开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身针对研究 agent 的实验算力，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其把计算拆成「答案需要／不需要／空闲」的核算方式，可能为 LVR 中推理期动态计算与停止决策的成本归因提供参照，且其「提高占用率或加调度并不能修复浪费」的结论可供核查。
